name: International Association for Inland Navigation
tagline: Pan-European association representing the interests of the inland navigation sector
hero_kpi_rationale: L'organisation est une association sectorielle sans activités commerciales. L'indicateur pertinent est la participation au congrès annuel, reflétant l'engagement et la portée de représentation internationale du secteur de la navigation intérieure européenne.

kpis.explanation: Total number of attendees at the IVR Annual Congress, reflecting the association's reach and member engagement.
kpis.signal: Strong member participation from 11 countries demonstrates robust international representation and sectoral engagement.
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17) attracted 225 participants from 11 different countries, representing a successful year for the association's flagship event.

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented in the association's membership and governance structure.
kpis.signal: Pan-European representation with membership spanning 11 countries demonstrates the association's international scope and neutrality.
kpis.description: The 2024 Annual Congress in Frankfurt demonstrated representation from 11 different European countries, reflecting the international character of the inland navigation sector.

kpis.name_fr: Participants au colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium, reflecting sectoral expertise and engagement in risk management.
kpis.signal: Inaugural event launched November 2024 in Antwerp with strong multi-country participation (Belgium, Netherlands, Germany) demonstrating member commitment to loss prevention knowledge exchange.
kpis.description: The first edition of the Loss Prevention Colloquium held on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp brought together approximately 80 participants from insurance, brokerage, claims management, shipping companies, and maritime law sectors.

kpis.name_fr: Réunions du comité de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of in-person Loss Prevention Committee meetings held during the fiscal year.
kpis.signal: Regular in-person committee engagement ensures continuous collaboration on technical standards and prevention initiatives.
kpis.description: The Loss Prevention Committee held 3 in-person meetings during 2024, addressing technical regulations, prevention challenges, and publishing recommendations for ship owners.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in IVR's activities or strategic initiatives. The organization focuses on sectoral representation, regulatory standards, and loss prevention in inland navigation.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation capabilities.
Activities center on industry representation, technical standards development (CESNI), and safety/loss prevention.
Digitalization mentioned only in context of regulatory standards for the inland shipping sector, not as organizational AI strategy.
No AI-driven products, services, or initiatives cited.
